source: Vercel AI Gateway documentation (video generation). The live catalog from verify-gateway.mjs is authoritative.
notes: Inputs must be hosted URLs for async jobs (inline data is capped at 300 KiB).
Kling camera control is mutually exclusive with first/last frame and motion brush.
Motion control: character image (jpg/png, up to 10 MB) plus a reference motion video (mp4/mov, 3-30 s, up to 100 MB).
Veo 3.1 image-to-video durations are 4, 6 or 8 s; Wan 2.6 is 2-15 s; Grok Imagine 1-15 s; Seedance 2.5 4-30 s.
